answer.answer: The maximum micro-loan amount stated for PMMY is Rs. 20 lakhs [E01]. The scheme facilitates micro credit/Loan up to Rs. 20 lakhs to income generating micro enterprises engaged in the non-farm sector [E01]. Within this overall limit, loans are categorized as: Shishu (up to Rs. 50,000), Kishore (above Rs. 50,000 up to Rs. 5 lakhs), Tarun (above Rs. 5 lakhs up to Rs. 10 lakhs), and Tarun Plus (up to Rs. 20 lakhs) [E02].

claim_to_evidence.claim: The maximum micro-loan amount for PMMY is Rs. 20 lakhs
The scheme has four loan categories: Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, and Tarun Plus
